entra-token.name: A valid Entra token for the right audience
entra-token.chooseWhen: the call fails with 401 or an AADSTS error: the token is missing, expired or for another resource (<environment URL>/.default)

application-user.name: Application user in the environment
application-user.chooseWhen: an application or managed identity authenticates but Dataverse says "not a member of the organization": create the application user per environment

security-role.name: Security role of the application user
security-role.chooseWhen: the call fails with 403 and "principal user is missing prv…": add that privilege at the needed depth

api-permission.name: Entra API permission with consent
api-permission.chooseWhen: a delegated (user) token needs a permission such as Dynamics CRM user_impersonation or CopilotStudio.Copilots.Invoke; it never authorises an app-only identity in Dataverse

azure-rbac.name: Azure role assignment
azure-rbac.chooseWhen: the identity must reach an Azure resource such as Key Vault or a storage queue; Azure roles don't grant Dataverse access

service-channel.name: A channel for service callers (Direct Line or the connector)
service-channel.chooseWhen: a background service with no user must talk to a Copilot Studio agent; the client library needs a user token
